text_block_list.name: VR Umulator
text_block_list.text:
"Starting the VR Umulator. Please input 
the data."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep, beep, beep—)

text_block_list.name: VR Umulator
text_block_list.text:
Starting simulation. —Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, Paddock.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El! Sorry to keep you waiting! So, what 
did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ! Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —May I ask you for a favor, yes?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Wait... THAT El Condor Pasa is your 
mentor...?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's right, Sensei. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll be able to board a plane. 
After all, you'd want to watch it in 
person, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my... Fufu, looks like a fire's been 
lit under me."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heck, you can even come watch the 
Takarazuka Kinen if you want. Just skip 
right past the rehab stage.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And so... ...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "...Festa?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Sensei has been alive for over a year 
since then.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So you can live longer. Long enough to 
even see my Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "............ ...Thank you, Festa."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"You, above all... make sure you... truly 
live."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm looking forward to it, too. To 
showing you the world, Sensei."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reserved the final slot of the day for 
the track. After checking with the 
groundskeeper to ensure it wouldn't impact 
tomorrow, I began soaking the turf with a 
hose.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Trying something interesting again, huh? 
The mud out there ain't no joke.
choice_data_list:
I prepared the heaviest track conditions 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I see. Rain and the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe really do go hand in hand, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So the plan is to use this training to 
handle bad track conditions on race day, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
“...... Yeah, exactly, with this kind of 
messy feel—”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...That's plenty, for the kind of 
training we can do here."
choice_data_list: ...Is "good enough" really enough, though?
...Is "good enough" really enough, though?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
............ Say what you will, there's 
only so much that can be done.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, let's do the absolute 
best we can.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Nakayama Festa, I fill out 
the entry paperwork for the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe.
choice_data_list:
(...The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is a 
massive race.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be surprising if this race 
completely altered the course of Nakayama 
Festa's life.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, retirement!? She just finally 
reached the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! Her 
competitive career was just getting 
started!"

text_block_list.name: Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...This is a place of longing and 
long-cherished dreams. A fitting place for 
an end."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Once your fighting spirit burns out to 
ashes, it's over! All that's left is to be 
trampled by the strong!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...When Sirius Symboli said that to me 
before, I didn't think much of it. 
However, now—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...? Trainer? Your hands have stopped 
moving.
choice_data_list: S-Sorry! All that's left is to submit it!

S-Sorry! All that's left is to hand it in, 
right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Please wait!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, if it's just paperwork for the 
Arc, we could handle that much ourselves—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Just one more year!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-senpai, give me one more year of 
your time! Please!!
choice_data_list: One year...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even if you were to run in the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe as you are now, you 
won't be able to take 1st place, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You still have more than enough power to 
take on the challenge. I'm sure you could 
achieve great results!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, that will only yield "decent 
results." ............It won't reach 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
…………Hey, hold on. What are you about to 
say?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El couldn't surpass the world! I know just 
how high that wall is better than anyone!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"So staying like this is no good!! Because 
you haven't even experienced a world-level 
race in the truest sense yet!"
choice_data_list: A world-class race...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I will ensure they get to 
experience it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If it's El and Spe-chan, we can get it 
ready. For your sake...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to bring us right back to 
our peak— back to when we competed against 
the best in the world.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Also, it's seriously just a tiny bit more, 
'kay. Seriously... seriously, really 
really...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—So please, give me some time! I swear, I 
won't ever make you regret it!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Our strength! Our experience, our regrets, 
our hopes! Please, let us entrust them all 
to you!!
choice_data_list: So in other words, race with you guys...?
So in other words, race with you all...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Please.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Nakayama-senpai, I know you 
can reach the place beyond our dreams.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Race against Spe-chan at the Takarazuka 
Kinen. And at the Japan Cup, against me— 
—please compete with us."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't screw with me! Changing our plans 
now of all times is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Even you've noticed by now, haven't 
you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everything you've done up until now... has 
led you to see something, hasn't it?
choice_data_list: ...What was visible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(…Training on the academy's turf won't be 
enough to prepare for this.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...How many dozens of rejections has it 
been now?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘The more I learned, the clearer and 
farther away that distance appeared.’"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...That's plenty, for the kind of 
training we can do here."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"You can't know what you truly need 
without experience and knowledge."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, right now, you understand, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All of you are lacking everything. Skills, 
experience, connections... even time.
choice_data_list: （……I knew it.）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, I had begun to understand. Ever since 
I started receiving El Condor Pasa's help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, a single fear had forced her to 
look away from that possibility.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...! But at this rate, I won't make it in 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If we don't go right now, Sensei's life 
will be in danger! She might not even make 
it to next year, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So it's fine even if you don't win, DESU 
KA!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The wall of the world is thick, dess! 
Giving empty comforting words won't get 
you anywhere!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El knows! The determination to deliver the 
greatest hope! And that's why winning is 
the only option!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: However, even then—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El is truly trying to entrust this to you 
all. That is precisely why she is training 
you with everything she has.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She may sometimes deliver the harsh truth 
without sugarcoating it. Even so, please 
be sure to listen to her. It comes not 
from malice, but from hope.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El wants to send you off with a smile too, 
saying you two will be just fine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa's legs were trembling 
slightly.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But now that I've noticed it! El just 
can't leave a problem unsolved...!
choice_data_list: ...I'm sorry for making you say that much.
...I'm sorry for making you say all that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
choice_data_list:
Thank you, even though it must have been 
hard to bring up.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“...... El doesn't have the right to make 
the final call. I leave it in your hands.”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I want El to win. I want her to 
endure and prepare for just one more year 
alongside someone who knows the world."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Because as someone who shows hope to 
others, I want her to face it in a state 
where she can actually inspire it."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
――... Please decide the rest between the 
two of you.
choice_data_list: Yeah. ...Nakayama, let's talk.
Yeah. ...Nakayama, let's talk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—How much time is left until the moon 
that began climbing the sky finally sets, 
I wonder.”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: Honestly, what do you think?
Honestly, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...A year is far too long.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I learned it the hard way last year, 
didn't I? The human body can turn fragile 
in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Even if she's held together by hope right 
now... ...will Sensei still be able to 
wait a year from now?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just let what I did end with 'it had 
meaning'...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Even if I keep dragging you into this, 
Trainer... Even if you give me hope... 
It's already... over...
choice_data_list: ...I see.
...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know what purpose she ran for, and who 
she sought to bring hope to, ever since 
her Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know she treated it as a gamble at 
first, and I know she thinks she can't do 
that anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Please, make the absolute most of her 
life... to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can no longer avert my eyes from the 
things I used to pretend not to see.
choice_data_list:
...Still, we can't just leave things like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Even as things are now, the chance of 
winning isn't zero, is it?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think so too.
Yeah, I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether we challenge it now or next year, 
there is never a guarantee that we will 
reap the reward of a victory in the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, if we were to challenge the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe as we are now—
choice_data_list:
When I lose, I just tell myself 'it 
couldn't be helped.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to make it in time for the 
remaining time she has. That's why she 
entered the race at this timing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That by then, we had done everything we 
possibly could.
choice_data_list:
Blaming someone else, saying it was all 
for their sake.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: Is that really okay?
Are you sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The only time you can stand tall and say 
it was your own gamble is when you chose 
the battle yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The responsibility lies in different 
places between 'a bet you had no choice 
but to make' and 'a bet you chose to 
make.'"
choice_data_list: I want to say it was our bet.
I want to say that I was our wager.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That's why I wanted to settle the doubts 
that had surfaced and put an end to any 
lingering regrets.
choice_data_list: Let's decide which path to take ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Still, the other option is a gamble 
with practically no chance of winning.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...So what if I told you that, after all, 
I choose to 'go right now'?"
choice_data_list:
If that's the challenge you chose in the 
end, I don't mind.

If that is the challenge you yourself have 
chosen in the end, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sure that gentle person in the 
hospital room would say the exact same 
thing.
choice_data_list:
Even if it's a one-way road to hell, I'll 
walk it with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the trainer's office alone, I 
pin the registration forms for the 'Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe' onto the room's 
whiteboard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Until the day her answer takes solid 
shape.
